[Section] Corpus Construction ::: Data acquisition ::: Eye-tracking acquisition
[source_id=36] Eye position and pupil size were recorded with an infrared video-based eye tracker (EyeLink 1000 Plus, SR Research) at a sampling rate of 500 Hz. The eye tracker was calibrated with a 9-point grid at the beginning of the session and re-validated before each block of sentences.
